children: DevvStream entered into Amendment No. 1 to its Business Combination Agreement with XCF Global and Southern Energy to revise deal economics and closing conditions. Post-merger, Southern holders are expected to own about 20%, DevvStream holders 10.43%, and existing XCF Global holders 69.57%. The amendment removes several prior closing conditions and is conditioned on a $1 million concurrent investment by GL via XCF Global’s warrant program. It also adds a post-closing funding commitment of at least $4.373 million within three months and a commercially reasonable efforts commitment to raise an additional $50 million within twelve months.

: Revise economics and streamline closing for the business combination
